Beige Book - March 2023 - National Summary

Overall Economic Activity

Overall economic activity was little changed in recent weeks. Several Districts noted heightened uncertainty following the recent banking stress. Contacts expected little relief in the months ahead.

Labor Markets

Employment continued to increase at a modest pace, but hiring plans became uncertain. Several Districts reported layoffs in technology and finance. Wage pressures eased somewhat.

Prices

Prices rose moderately in most Districts. Input cost pressures eased for manufacturers.
